headline: Commanders WR Terry McLaurin has torn patellar tendon, ending his season
summary: Commanders wide receiver Terry McLaurin suffered a torn patellar tendon, an injury that will end his season, coach Dan Quinn announced Tuesday.

headline: Rams put Davante Adams, Poona Ford on IR
summary: Wide receiver Davante Adams is expected to miss the next 6-10 weeks after rupturing his hamstring in last Sunday's loss to the Cardinals and the Rams moved him off of the active roster on Tuesday.

headline: NFL chief medical officer: Eagles' approach to Hurts was 'appropriately guarded'
summary: At the owners meetings Tuesday in New York, NFL officials staunchly defended the process involving Philadelphia Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts and his blood clot issue, with chief medical officer Allen Sills addressing reporters in a media availability.
